summary: Computes a CRC over a byte buffer using the dword_5B7860 lookup table, starting from a seed argument. An unrolled main loop processes 8 bytes per iteration, then a tail loop handles the remaining bytes one at a time. Returns the bitwise complement of the final CRC state. A null data pointer returns 0 immediately.

operations.description: If the data pointer argument a2 is null, return 0 immediately without computing a CRC.
Seed the CRC state from the initial value argument; the seed is referenced through the low byte (field 0x0) and the upper bits (field 0x2) of the initial value.

Unrolled main loop: while at least 8 bytes remain, consume 8 bytes per iteration, updating the CRC state by XORing the shifted state with dword_5B7860 table entries keyed by the current byte XORed with the low byte of the state.
Tail loop: consume the remaining 0-7 bytes one at a time, each updating the CRC state through the dword_5B7860 table.
Return the bitwise complement of the final CRC state.
